description: intrinsic cohesive_bilinear on x = 0.5 (Kuhn Tet4 n = 4), explicit, v_x = 0.2 (2x - 1), rank view

build.cxx_flags: -ffp-contract=off -DEIGEN_DONT_VECTORIZE -DEIGEN_NO_CPUID -DEIGEN_DEFAULT_L1_CACHE_SIZE=16384 -DEIGEN_DEFAULT_L2_CACHE_SIZE=524288 -DEIGEN_DEFAULT_L3_CACHE_SIZE=524288 -O2 -g -DNDEBUG -g3 -ggdb3 -flarge-source-files -std=c++20 -flto=auto -fno-fat-lto-objects -fPIC -frounding-math (actual flags of src/model/solid_mechanics/solid_mechanics_model.cc; warnings and non-FP -D defines omitted)

parameters.material_dat:
model solid_mechanics_model_cohesive [
  cohesive_inserter [
    bounding_box = [[0.49, 0.51], [-10, 10], [-10, 10]]
  ]
  material elastic [
    name = bulk
    rho = 1e3
    E = 1e3
    nu = 0.1
  ]
  material cohesive_bilinear [
    name = cohesive
    sigma_c = 1
    beta = 1.5
    G_c = 1
    delta_0 = 0.1
  ]
]
parameters.ghost_filter_order: canonical rank order (probe patch): bulk ghost filters after initFull, cohesive ghost filters after each insertion (entries appended by it), receive schemes in rank order; the number of reordered blocks (run-dependent upstream) is logged as GHOST_FILTER_REORDERED
